tickets.diagnosis: Moisture found in motor temperature sensor connector J4.
tickets.resolution: Dried connector, replaced seal, applied dielectric grease, and cleared E17.

tickets.diagnosis: CAN harness at the battery was not fully seated after service.
tickets.resolution: Reseated and latched the CAN harness; completed ten successful restarts.

tickets.diagnosis: Suspected internal cell damage; pack quarantined for engineering analysis.
tickets.resolution: Charging stopped, area evacuated, pack moved by trained response team to isolation container.
